|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">アーメックSW－4銃座設置式イオン砲。イオン化されたエネルギー線を放射し、目標の機構やコンピュータ・システムに過負荷を起こさせる。これを使用すれば船を捕獲し、乗り込むことができる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' SW-4 ion cannon.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on any Y-wing or B-wing. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. Hit if destiny > the target's armor or maneuver. All weapons aboard the target are lost, and the target's armor/maneuver = 0 and hyperspeed = 0.

'''Lore:'''
An ArMek SW-4 turret-mounted ion cannon. It fires ionized energy and overloads the target's machinery and computer systems. Using it lets you capture a ship and board it.
